heading: Supplement to Federal reclamation laws; short title
lead: This subchapter shall be a supplement to the Federal reclamation laws and may be cited as the Small Reclamation Projects Act of 1956.

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: The Federal reclamation laws, referred to in text, are defined in section 422b of this title.
